Title: [LSJ] Lunatic Eruption and Rescue From Torpor

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
A short question :

It is my turn. I control a vampire with Lunatic Eruption and 3 blood on
him/her who is in torpor. It is the beginning of my minion phase, mandatory
actions must be taken. As the vampire is in torpor he cannot attack a
vampire of my prey.

Can he rescue himself from torpor or not ?

If no is it a general rule that if a vampire fails to do a mandatory action
cannot take actions regardless if he is untapped ?

greetings and merry christmas,

--
johannes walch
v:ekn germany - http://www.vekn.de
johanne...@vekn.de

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Johannes Walch wrote:
> It is my turn. I control a vampire with Lunatic Eruption and 3 blood on
> him/her who is in torpor. It is the beginning of my minion phase, mandatory
> actions must be taken. As the vampire is in torpor he cannot attack a
> vampire of my prey.
>
> Can he rescue himself from torpor or not ?

Yes.

> If no is it a general rule that if a vampire fails to do a mandatory action
> cannot take actions regardless if he is untapped ?

"fails" is a bit misleading there.
A minion with a mandatory action to perform cannot take any other action.
But Lunatic Eruption doesn't give an unready vampire a mandtory action.

To make it more clear. I have a ready vampire with Lunatic Eruption and my
prey has one single vampire and this vampire has a Secure Haven. Is it the
same in this case ? Is it a general rule that in case no valid target for a
normally mandatory action exists the action is not mandatory ?

What about the following situation : I have 2 vampires, 1 with Lunatic
Eruption and my prey has a Vampire with Secure Haven. In my minion phase I
cannot attack because of the Secure Haven (mandatory actions first) then I
destroy the Secure Haven with Arson. Does the Lunatic Vampire attack now ?

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Johannes Walch wrote:

> To make it more clear. I have a ready vampire with Lunatic Eruption
> and my prey has one single vampire and this vampire has a Secure

> Haven. Is it the same in this case ? Is it a general rule that in case

> no valid target for a normally mandatory action exists the action is
> not mandatory ?

No, if a mandatory action requires a target, the vampire doing it will
be unable to perform any action if there are no valid targets.

> What about the following situation : I have 2 vampires, 1 with Lunatic
> Eruption and my prey has a Vampire with Secure Haven. In my minion
> phase I cannot attack because of the Secure Haven (mandatory actions
> first) then I destroy the Secure Haven with Arson. Does the Lunatic
> Vampire attack now ?

Yes. Note that the Lunatic vampire could not perform any action until
the Secure Haven is destroyed.

Flux
